summary: An April Fools' RFC that jokingly proposes to boost IPv6 by turning social networking platforms into IPv6 networks, instantly adding millions of hosts. It is humor and not a real protocol.

eli5.summary: Not many computers used the new internet addressing, so this joke suggests simply counting everyone on social networks as using it. It is only a silly idea for April 1st.

questions: what is ipv6 over social networks
